c001.coordinator_notes: Rejected all eight native predictions. Eq 1 (a Lindblad-like form) is a Markovian-style generator that is not supported by the abstract, so it does not describe non-Markovian dynamics. Eqs 2 and 3 are malformed or non-standard (a time-ordered exponential of a Liouvillian labelled as a unitary). Eqs 4-8 are generic fidelity or product definitions, with eq 7 dimensionally odd; none were used. They were replaced by the sketch's Hamiltonian, Magnus error generators and cost, labelled assumption or background. I did not read the paper. The built circuit only reproduces the ideal gate and does not demonstrate noise suppression.

c002.coordinator_notes: The equation specialist's prediction, a generic driven-qubit Hamiltonian with ω0 σz/2 + B_x σx + B_y σy, was not used verbatim. It is a standard open-system control model that does not match the singlet-triplet form here, and it is unverified. I replaced it with the segment Hamiltonian from the sketch (assumption). I added the product-of-exponentials equation as background. The error-vector equation is inferred from the abstract and the sketch. The space-curve geometry and the filter-function equations are not included, and I did not claim the pulses cancel errors. This reconstruction is from the abstract alone; I have not read the paper.
